configuration.status: PROTOTYPE / DRAFT; vacuum magnetostatic design, not construction approval

stations.depth_basis: Provisional500mm ATLAS-like whole-chamber envelope; two3/4-plane30mm-tube multilayers and up to317mm spacers guide scale. No internals, supports or installation qualification.

endcap.reason: Raise endcap current to compensate barrel-return cancellation in transition; chosen before final map from signed response scan.

central_field.scope: complete joint vacuum field in nominal tracker R<=1.2m, |z|<=3.6m; grid, not all-space maximum

energy_cold_volume.method: exact tube volume minus adjacent-pair inner-corner overlap; analytic y and Gauss-Legendre x
energy_cold_volume.interpretation: unique shared geometric allocation only; not conductor or support mass, pressure boundary, or construction acceptance
energy_cold_volume.scope: global complete vacuum coupled-system U/V rule only; no local coil stress/thermal/conductor qualification

fine_transition_scan.scope: sampled clear straight rays only; not global acceptance/efficiency or a continuum performance bound

observable_assumptions.precision_coordinates: barrel z, disks r; projected perpendicular to initial ray in RZ; independent station errors
observable_assumptions.method: straight high-p ray, signed Bphi sagitta; unequal3station interpolation; uniform internal scattering; not a reconstruction or transport simulation
observable_assumptions.upstream_material: HCAL/ECAL/solenoid energy loss and scattering are not re-run or charged as internal curvature material; see PR86

map.status: joint finite-coil VACUUM field, no HCAL magnetization
map.contents: combined field only; source decomposition in field-components.npz at doubled RZ / quadrupled phi spacing
map.periodicity: C12: cylindrical components repeat every30deg; rotate Br/Bphi to global Cartesian at requested phi
map.mask: NaN in finite current-pack plus0.10m guard; no extrapolation; warm sweep mask separate
map.solenoid: axisymmetric continuous winding approximated by3radial x96axial Gauss loops,192polygon edges; B(0) normalized3T
map.toroid: 4x4 uniform pack Gauss filaments;16segments per rounded corner; each straight segment exact
map.query: tools.toroid_prototype.map.FieldMap.field(points_Nx3_metres) returns Cartesian tesla; rejects invalid stencil/outside domain

interpolation_control.scope: deterministic random clear3hit gap samples, >=0.30m outside warm reservations; not a near-coil/global bound
